notes: Asking Crisp to REMOVE something no longer adds it. "Remove the ugly border" was adding a border, "remove that watermark" was offering to add one, and "cut the boring first 5 seconds" kept exactly those five seconds — any describing word slipped past the guard. Asking about the "Made with Crisp" mark now tells you how it comes off. Cutting a chunk out of the middle explains the two-split recipe instead of keeping the chunk. And "a two and a half minute recap" is no longer a thirty-second one.
